candidates.title: Let Me Game in Peace
candidates.author: Twelve-Winged Dark Seraphim / 十二翼黑暗炽天使
candidates.summary: Real dimensional zones become dungeon instances on a phone. One drop of blood buys another game life, while defeated creatures yield crystals, skills and companion beasts. This separates bodily danger from repeated simulated attempts, but still makes repetition consume something in the real body instead of offering an unlimited reset button.

unknowns: Blood recovery and retry limits.

candidates.proposal: Proposal: let a safe rehearsal spend a real bodily resource and export only named reward types.
